title: Joe Firmage's Inter NASA group

tellings.quote: I believe he started this group called Inter NASA, which was based on the Academy of Arts and Sciences.

plain: A man named Joe Firmage is said to have started a group called Inter NASA, modeled on the Academy of Arts and Sciences. Michels says so himself, with some hesitation ("I believe"), in an episode with the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, and he does not say what the group did.
